image_description: The image displays two toy dinosaur figures against a white background. The primary subject is a large, light-green Triceratops figure in the upper center, featuring three horns and a large frill. Below it is a smaller, orange/brown quadrupedal dinosaur figure (resembling an Ankylosaurus or similar armored dinosaur). Between them is a logo for 'Zoo Friends' with some illegible text.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Three prominent horns: two long brow horns projecting forward and upward above the eyes, and a shorter nasal horn on the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The green figure clearly exhibits the classic triceratops horn configuration: two large brow horns and one smaller nasal horn.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beak is parrot-like with a sharp, keratinous cutting edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth area of the green figure shows a distinct beak structure consistent with ceratopsian anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is quadrupedal with columnar, elephant-like limbs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The figure stands on four sturdy, column-like legs, accurately reflecting the quadrupedal stance.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Enormous bony frill (neck shield) extending posteriorly from the skull, with width dramatically exceeding the skull itself.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The large, fan-shaped frill is the most dominant feature behind the head, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Frill is solid bone with a smooth outer surface and possible epoccipital (marginal) bumps.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frill appears solid (not fenestrated) and has small bumps along the rim, consistent with epoccipitals.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is inferred to have been covered in large, hexagonal scales with possible quill-like structures along the back and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image depicts a smooth plastic toy. The specific biological texture of hexagonal scales or quills is not rendered; instead, it has a uniform molded plastic texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forelimbs are shorter than hindlimbs creating a sloping backline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The posture shows the characteristic slope from hips to shoulders, indicating shorter forelimbs.
The tail visible behind the hind legs is short and thick, matching the anatomical expectation.

artifact_observations.location: Center of the image, between the two dinosaurs
artifact_observations.reasoning: The logo text 'Zoo Friends' is recognizable but slightly distorted and blurry, typical of AI-generated text or low-resolution composites. The tagline below is largely illegible gibberish.

The skin texture is unnaturally smooth and uniform, lacking the fine surface detail expected of either a realistic biological rendering or a high-quality photograph of a textured toy. It has a 'waxy' AI-smoothed appearance.

artifact_observations.location: Eye region of the green Triceratops
artifact_observations.reasoning: The eye lacks a clear pupil/iris definition and appears as a dark, melted depression rather than a distinct anatomical feature. The surrounding horn base also blends slightly into the skull without a clear socket boundary.
